rationale: emailservice latency-90 rose from 0.0046 to 0.2125 (z=+899) and latency-50 rose from 0.003 to 0.0432 (z=+267), the largest shifts in the digest, while emailservice CPU is flat (+3.9%, z=0.44) and its workload is unchanged. checkoutservice, its caller, shows a smaller latency rise (p90 +105.7%), consistent with propagation from emailservice, and the service map has no other path that explains it; with no warning or error logs, delay is inferred from the latency pattern alone.

proposed_fix.description: Investigate network latency to/from emailservice (e.g. check for injected delay or network degradation on its pod/node) and restore normal network conditions; consider a timeout or async call for email sending in checkoutservice to limit impact. No data deletion or restarts required initially.
